title: Special meeting to authorize closed session
subtitle: Closed session on land disposition, land acquisition, legal advice and a personnel matter; one councillor declared a conflict.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on April 8, 2024. It began at 6:23 p.m. and adjourned at 6:25 p.m. There were no delegations and no mayoral business or updates.

The only decision was to hold a closed session right after the meeting. Council authorized it to consider a land disposition, a land acquisition and solicitor-client privilege matter, and a personnel matter about an identifiable individual. The Municipal Act, 2001 allows councils to meet privately on these topics {{vote:m1}}.
One councillor declared a conflict of interest on the affordable housing opportunity land disposition item because of employment. That councillor did not take part in discussion or voting on it.
No decisions on these matters were made in public at this meeting. Residents should watch for any later public reports or votes once the closed-session items move forward.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to meet in camera after the special meeting to consider a land disposition, a land acquisition and solicitor-client privilege matter, and a personnel matter about an identifiable individual {{vote:m1}}.

debate: No debate took place on the motion to go into closed session; the chair asked for discussion and none was recorded in the transcript.

A councillor declared a pecuniary interest in the affordable housing land disposition item, saying it might affect their employment. The chair asked the clerk to confirm the item number and reminded the councillor to complete the required paperwork.
